---
title: "More Details on Comparability of Groups"
---

## Did the lottery create comparable groups?

A lottery should produce two groups that look alike before the programme starts. Check it.

```{=html}
<figure class="fig-e">
<svg viewBox="0 0 680 320" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" role="img" aria-label="Illustrative balance check: treatment and comparison bars of near-equal length for firm age, revenue, employees and sector mix">
  <text x="20" y="26" fill="var(--dg-ink-soft)" font-size="10.5" letter-spacing="1.5" font-weight="bold">ILLUSTRATIVE, NOT REAL DATA</text>

  <text x="20" y="66" fill="var(--dg-ink)" font-size="12" font-weight="bold">Firm age</text>
  <rect x="150" y="52" width="300" height="14" fill="var(--dg-ink)"/>
  <rect x="150" y="70" width="290" height="14" fill="var(--dg-accent)"/>

  <text x="20" y="130" fill="var(--dg-ink)" font-size="12" font-weight="bold">Revenue</text>
  <rect x="150" y="116" width="340" height="14" fill="var(--dg-ink)"/>
  <rect x="150" y="134" width="352" height="14" fill="var(--dg-accent)"/>

  <text x="20" y="194" fill="var(--dg-ink)" font-size="12" font-weight="bold">Employees</text>
  <rect x="150" y="180" width="260" height="14" fill="var(--dg-ink)"/>
  <rect x="150" y="198" width="268" height="14" fill="var(--dg-accent)"/>

  <text x="20" y="258" fill="var(--dg-ink)" font-size="12" font-weight="bold">Sector mix</text>
  <rect x="150" y="244" width="310" height="14" fill="var(--dg-ink)"/>
  <rect x="150" y="262" width="302" height="14" fill="var(--dg-accent)"/>

  <rect x="150" y="296" width="11" height="11" fill="var(--dg-ink)"/>
  <text x="168" y="306" fill="var(--dg-ink-soft)" font-size="11.5">Treatment</text>
  <rect x="260" y="296" width="11" height="11" fill="var(--dg-accent)"/>
  <text x="278" y="306" fill="var(--dg-ink-soft)" font-size="11.5">Comparison</text>
</svg>
<figcaption>If the groups look the same before the programme starts, the lottery probably worked. Small differences are normal; large systematic ones are a warning sign.</figcaption>
</figure>
```

<div class="case-band"><b>SMART Romania</b><span>&check; The application survey collected the baseline data used for this check</span></div>

::: {.team-note}
**Data gap**
The balance bars are illustrative. The baseline report does not publish a treatment and
control balance table. Once the team shares the actual balance results, replace the bars
with the real characteristics and values, and remove the on-figure caveat.
:::

```{=html}
<div class="tracker"><span>Enough firms</span><span class="sep">&rsaquo;</span><span>Comparable groups</span><span class="sep">&rsaquo;</span><span class="on">Outcomes</span><span class="sep">&rsaquo;</span><span>Right design</span></div>
```




::: {.takeaway}
Fix the outcomes before the draw: choosing them afterwards invites cherry-picking.
:::
